purpose: Pilot whether ordered semantic-role supervision and transformation-aware consistency improve correct role transfer in a pretrained decoder model.
model: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct local unmodified snapshot before LoRA
design: One 10-name graph, 20 observed and 25 withheld unordered pairs. All arms train on identical 240 examples: 20 observed pairs x 3 verbs x 2 directions x 2 voices. Only actor question 'Who performed the action?' is in training. Four matched training groups plus unmodified reference.

training.generic_consistency: Same supervised loss plus Jensen-Shannon agreement of two-name actor distributions between active/passive renderings of each directed event.
training.ordered_roles: Same supervised loss plus ordered actor and patient ID cross-entropy from the final prompt state.
training.ordered_plus_transformations: Same supervised loss and ordered heads, plus voice agreement and Jensen-Shannon equivariance when the two participant roles are reversed.
training.matched: Same group ordering, all four sentence variants per group, LoRA architecture and initialization, two epochs (120 updates), learning rate 1e-4, no test-based tuning. Each additional objective uses the same four training examples. Explicit attention masks exclude only leading batch pads in every training arm, matching evaluation.

evaluation: All 45 name pairs x two directions x five verbs (three seen and two unseen) x four forms (two seen and two unseen clefts) x three fixed actor questions (one seen and two unseen) = 5400 prompts per arm. Greedy first token; exact actor name counts correct; invalid token wrong. Primary pilot subset is 25 withheld pairs x 2 directions x 3 seen verbs x 2 seen forms x 3 questions (900 prompts). Also report unseen verbs, unseen forms, all-variant event correctness, invalid rate, per-pair results and familiar-pair retention. No post-hoc exclusions.
interpretation: One graph, one training start and one small model family constitute a feasibility and direction pilot. A repair claim requires fresh graph, independent starts and model families with frozen replication criteria. Version 2 training omitted attention masks for left-padded examples; those trained results are invalid. Its unmodified baseline did not involve this training bug and is retained as a fixed reference on identical test rows.
